# stemtools

Color palettes, ploting functions and more for working at Stem.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `stemtools` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("stem-cz/stemtools")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`collapse_cats()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/collapse_cats.md)
  : Collapses factor levels and returns a new data frame
- [`create_project()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/create_project.md)
  : Scaffold a new Stem analysis project
- [`scale_fill_stem()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/scale_colour_stem.md)
  [`scale_colour_stem()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/scale_colour_stem.md)
  [`scale_color_stem()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/scale_colour_stem.md)
  : stem discrete colour and fill scales for ggplot2
- [`se_mean()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/se_mean.md)
  : Computes parametric standard error for mean
- [`se_median()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/se_median.md)
  : Computes parametric standard error for median
- [`se_prop()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/se_prop.md)
  : Computes parametric standard error for proportions
- [`select_diverging()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/select_diverging.md)
  : Select n colours from a diverging palette
- [`stem_add_chart()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_add_chart.md)
  : Add a Stem plot to a PowerPoint or Word document as a native chart
- [`stem_as_mschart()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_as_mschart.md)
  : Convert a Stem plot into a native Microsoft chart
- [`stem_barplot()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_barplot.md)
  : Horizontal bar plot
- [`stem_battery()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_battery.md)
  : Stacked bar plot for a battery of like items
- [`stem_export_docx()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_export_docx.md)
  : Export Stem plots to Word as native charts
- [`stem_export_pptx()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_export_pptx.md)
  : Export Stem plots to PowerPoint as native charts
- [`stem_inline()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_inline.md)
  : Inline stacked bar plot
- [`stem_multiselect()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_multiselect.md)
  : Bar plot for a set of multiple-choice items
- [`stem_palette()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_palette.md)
  : Retrieve a stem colour palette
- [`stem_palette_gen()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_palette_gen.md)
  : Colour palette generator factory
- [`stem_palettes_all()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_palettes_all.md)
  : Display all available stem palettes
- [`stem_summarise()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_summarise.md)
  : Summarise numeric or categorical variable (possibly segmented)
- [`stem_summarise_cat()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_summarise_cat.md)
  : Summarise categorical variable (possibly segmented)
- [`stem_summarise_num()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/stem_summarise_num.md)
  : Summarise numeric variable using arithmetic mean (possibly
  segmented)
- [`theme_stem()`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/theme_stem.md)
  : Complete ggplot2 theme for Stem.
- [`trust`](https://stem-cz.github.io/stemtools/reference/trust.md) :
  Simulated data on attitudes towards institutions
